name: @disk-tree/pages-kit
description: What disky's Pages apps share (`site/`, `fleet/`): server-drawn cards (SVG → PNG through resvg-wasm, signed card URLs, text and axis helpers, the cards' shared frame, a deployment's status card) and "Sign in with OA" (the broker's OIDC config, its routes, silent sign-in). Consumed as TypeScript source.
